items.title: Lesson Podcast

items.title: Barb: The gold standard in television audience measurement — Barb

items.title: How Do TV Ratings Work? — BrainStuff

items.title: Hidden Figures: Understanding TV Audiences in the On-Demand Age — Royal Television Society
items.description: Industry experts on how on-demand platforms have complicated audience measurement — directly relevant to BARB and RAJAR challenges.

items.description: Official BARB website — explore the weekly top 50 and understand how the UK's TV audience data is structured.
